div.div: طَوَائِحُ i. q. قَوَاذِفُ, (S, A, K,) i. e. Accidents, or events, that cast into places of perdition: (MF, * TK:) said in the 'Ináyeh to be an anomalous pl. of ↓ مُطِيحَةٌ , from أَطَاحَ meaning “ he, or it, caused to pass away, ” and “ to perish, or come to nought. ” (MF.) See 2.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
